panel.failed: Output could not be read from this machine.
panel.tooOld: This machine runs an older Ruimte. Update it to keep Output there.
panel.empty: An agent publishes a result to Output, and you save a page or an image from a chat with Save to Output.

view.gone: This is no longer in Output on this machine.
view.versionGoneDetail: This version is no longer on this machine. The others are still here.
view.unreachable: The machine is not reachable. Output stays on it and shows here again once it is back.
view.compareOff: Only a report of one text file can be compared
view.noChange: These two versions are the same.
view.downloadTooLarge: Larger than {{size}}, too large to download here. Copy it to the project instead.
view.downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded
view.readFailed: This file could not be read
view.noPreview: This kind has no preview. Download a file or copy it into the project.

copyHere.tip: Keeps a copy of this version in Output of {{project}} on this machine.
copyHere.unreachable: {{machine}} did not answer. Try again once it is back.
copyHere.unlinked: This project is no longer linked on {{machine}}.
copyHere.gone: This version is no longer on {{machine}}.
copyHere.mismatch: What {{machine}} sent did not match what it keeps, so nothing was copied.
copyHere.diskFull: The disk of this machine is too full. Nothing was copied.
copyHere.tooLarge: This version is larger than this machine keeps in Output.

node.notHereDetail: This node shows Output that someone keeps on their own machine.
node.removedDetail: What this node showed is no longer in Output on this machine.

info.note: Ruimte noted this when the version was saved. An agent cannot change it.

copy.name: Name

copy.exists: {{path}} exists. Ruimte never overwrites a file.
copy.failed: The copy did not go through
